statement.zh: von der Way《Tell el-Faraʻîn – Buto I》(AV 83, 1997) 正式公布 1983–1989 年布托早期（前王朝–早王朝）层位发掘成果。
statement.en: von der Way’s Tell el-Faraʻîn – Buto I (AV 83, 1997) formally publishes early (Predynastic–Early Dynastic) context results from the 1983–1989 Buto campaigns.
